comparisonGroup: Same season and NHL position; existing five-on-five eligibility group.
suppressionDirection: (Positional mean minus player rate) divided by population standard deviation.
bonusPolicy: Proportional positive credit. No positional-average subtraction.
missingDataPolicy: Below-cutoff seasons remain unscored. Invalid eligible inputs fail the run.
seasonComparisonGroup: Same season and NHL position; eligible defensive season indices.
historicalAggregation: Equal average of eligible season indices within the configured three-season window, followed by positional percentile calculation.
historicalComparisonGroup: Latest recorded NHL position within the historical window; players with at least one eligible season.
percentileMethod: 100 * (players below + half the players tied) / comparison group size. Uses unrounded indices.
ratingMethod: Percentile divided by 10, rounded to one decimal.
note: Provisional descriptive defensive ratings, not overall player value. Season and historical grading use the same shared helpers as offense. A rounded 10.0 does not indicate perfection. On-ice results are unadjusted for teammates, goaltending, opponents and deployment.
